book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Sesoanamba Nengavnangva Lohvna, Osm Lopshalm Pim.

content: Pimba himba nomba memba keknamba avpa undnahonamba, kolvrowol velohra henomoa, hindva nomba temba hoahmba undnahonamba amnavpa, wo noinda himba lohohsamamba othuwul wulvahvpa innena pulna tatanamba, hlalmba. Pioa hemoa kolvrowol velohra, manam pimba pivmangasva nesmos vewol vivra.
Pioa indakonda pivna mongawa Kristusnindmoa longong avramana velohra, osm hevna kelsra heoa eva arata.
Eva Kristusva lohmba owai venata hevmba, osm noinda kaoa undoa lothora. Memba honamba Sesoana doaramini tombaimora lohvm,

content.text: Kristusva Sesoam omnana, nonamba indhanamba yemba sahonamba vinitava, temba himba kam indkokla vrivra. Buk Song 69:9

content: Wo manimani temba doarava novol velohnamba, pimba numhowol velmba, osmba pivva no nengavnangna avra. Wo nomba nengavnangva pim suwenamandna vewol ovov, osm pimba si beswonam nengviluwuvra, osm Sesoava si pimba vuhebesalla sandhavra.

Tanam Sesoava pimba suwenamandna vewol ovov, noinda kava sembayang venav, osm Sesoava si yemba indkumbimba kolvrowol vevra, mongawa nengavnangnam alm pevna mongawa Kristusnindmongom, Yesus Kristusva undva vrinv osm.
Wo yimba si os apawohavra mongawulmba, wo yimba si okulivra Sesoamba pina mendeklina aral, Yesus Kristusna.
Kristusva yemba wohpepavena nihra, wo eva yeoa os pepeiviuta pevna mongawa Kristusnindmongom nihra. Honindava si indhanamba Sesoamba okulivra.
Kava men yemba ishunv, Kristusva luhunvna, Yutanindm kolvrowolalm. Honamba memba, osm Sesoava temba wonishonamba simbehumunmba doarava, pimba uvra, doa tanam wohphona.
Wo hev vena, honam vena, osm nomba Yutanindna meisungundva, heoa eva Sesoamoa okulivrata, noindaoa himba temba hemba wavra vovhueinnamba. Men novol velohlav Sesoana doaramini tombairava,

content.text: Devit Sesoam omnana, kava si yemba wivevra Yutanindna meisungundhovra. Kava si sangalva ovovravra, nihilm yenam okolalm. Buk Song 18:49

content: Eva Sesoana doaramini tombai vena, os ona,

content.text: Yeoa Yutanindna meisungundoa, yeoa undwonam losnamona ao, mongawulm Sesoanindmongo. Lo 32:43

content: Wo hengava Sesoana doaramini tombaiva os ona,

content.text: Yeoa indkumbioa Yutanindna meisungundoa okulivm mendeklimoa. Yeoa indkumbioa sangaloa ovuvrimnivm, okolalm hemoa nonam. Buk Song 117:1

content: Wo eva osta Aisaiava os onata,

content.text: Mongo nemel king kuwulva si provav Yesitindirini. Himba si provav, kuwulm wulluhunilm Yutanindna meisungundm, wo noinda himba si nengavnangva vruwuvra, osva himba si provavpa, pim kolvrowolalm velm. Aisaia 11:10

content: Sesoava doa pimba ishunna honamba moamba besal. Noinda kava sembayang vev, osm Sesoava si os yemba pilivhoawol vevav, esvema undlotholna, eva undwonamba almba, nonamba yimba hemba keknamba amnavrava. Wo yenamba nengavnangva si os pilivhoawol vinvra Sesoasongolna keknasowolna, tanam Sesoava si pimba vuhebesalla sandhavra.
Polva Ishunvna Hevna Andramom.
Seh, kava nengv, osva yemba doa pilivhoawol vena besalnana. Kava nengv, osva yimba av mindnam nowolnamba, nomba yimba ningvpa, nonamba pevmba monglamba numhowolalmba, osva henom henom henom.

Wo heva os kava doa novol vini yemba men honinda, nomba kava yemba osva ninginvpa, nengeuvmona wohvera. Yimba loupetava vitava, eva manapenam. Kava vei honamba, noinda osra Sesoa vraohna kamba honamba moainalva andrava,

luhunilm andranindrinielm Kristus Yesusna, Yutanindna meisungundm kolvrowolalm. Kava andra venav Sesoamba, nona numhowol vevm hevna besal nemelmona, osm nomba Yutanindna meisungundva Kristusmba undnahonam keknam lovahthamnavra, wo osva Sesoava hemba beswonam nongalvra. Os maim ovra, kava innemba suwera wohwuweihamnav Sesoam, osm noinda heoa indk vethara. Wo Sesoasongolva si nomba meisungundmba weihaloh vewol vevav Sesoatindinonowolm.
Wo kava indk vethav, noinda manimani memba kava venanamba Sesoamba Yesus Kristusnanamba.

Kava ata ishovavmoa nomba manimani, memba kava kavpa venamba. Kava ata nomangas ishovra, Kristus noi ten venam kana englana, deisumbi sihalm Yutanindna meisungundm, Sesoam engalm. Himba wohengivna Sesoamba, noinda osra, nomba ka vevna, ishovna, eva vevnam.

Wo himba wohengivna Sesoamba, noinda osra, mendekli andrana keknasowolla, eva mana vema mendeklim, hev nom nunglivnam, wo eva Sesoasongolna keknasowolla. Kava ishovna besal nemelmom, di Yerusalemram vranamba, venamba, wohlehra vethana kembelmba diva Ilirikum provinsmba. Wo kava os wohvipiana kavna andrava diva.

Manara, kava elsus nenglohvna, ishomana velmba besal nemelmomba dom no kembellam, ten hina avnam, os Kristusmomba hillivnamoa, owainonoa. Kava vevna honamba, noinda osra, kava nengvnamoa, velmba andrava, nomba mongnindva temba doava kovohlanamba.
Manara, men novol velohv Sesoana doaramini tombaimora,

content.text: Hindmba nomba temba hemba ishomba owai vinvpa hemomba, si nunglivav, wo hindva nomba temba hellemba owai vivpa hemomba, si hillivav. Aisaia 52:15

content: Polnamba Nengavnangva Lohvna, Rom Galm.
Honi andrava, nemelmomba ishomana vinilmba, kamba kevrawulavna, domba prunilmba yeindamba.
Heva os doa kava vipiana kavnamba andrava huiva. Tahonmba kava doa mindnam vungana, malsowa owovnam, domba prolmba.
Noinda kava nengvna, nungsis vepralm yemba momnanam, os Spen monam kav provram. Kava si und wonlothovav yemba, wo yimba si kamba kolvrivra monarava.
Wo doa men kava gav Yerusalem, Sesoatindim kolvrowolalm.
Wo Kristusnindva diva Masetoniara eva Akaiara, himba moamba doa vrina nomba, osmba dim wulkusolm, innehuinindm daswolalm, nom Sesoatindim, ten avm Yerusalemra.

Himba wohindk vithivna honamba, osmba velmba, wo himba nis ambo tanam wohvinvna hemba. Wo Yutanindna meisungundva among vinvm Yutanindmba, Yutanindva os ovna, memba esesmba, temba kava hemba besal nemelmomba eishunvnamba seilnovrava. Wo noinda Sesoava hemba doa eva awothowolnamba, hilvnisna kamongo Yutanindmongo.
Doa kava andram boasna vipialm vev, Yeruslemnindm dim moang vinilm, noi ten hevm wulksunnam. Wo doa kava honamba vipiarava, wo kava si os gavav Spenmba, yemba momnanam nongalkohavav.
Kava nengvpa, os kava nonamba prunvavpa yeindamba, kava si wulprovav Kristusna awothowolva.

Seh, kava ishunv yemba, osm kam kulvru kavna andrara, yeoa kamoa sembayang vinivm. Vivm honaoa, noinda osra pina mendekliva Yesus, eva wevsa pivna, ten piv und vewol vivm pivm henom henom, Sesoasongol pimba wohtv, velmba honamba.

Sembayang vivm, osm Sesoava si kamba dandana vrevav Yutanindnapenamba diva Yutia provinsrava, noi ten Kristusm amnam owai vivm. Wo sembayang vivm, osm nomba diva kava guavav Yerusalemram, si indhanamba indk vithimnivav Sesoamba di.
Wo Sesoava kamba omnatava, osva wouta, kava si osva prunvav yeindamba. Kava si provav losnamona, wo vera, ye ka mongawulm pimba si eha vewuvav.
Wo Sesoava nomba temba himba daswolvpa, undwonamba almba, yeinda di luhunda.
